AUDIT QUESTION: Try to BREAK this diff to pipeline/transcript_store.py: a stored live record (is_live / is_upcoming / post_live) is read again before the video is skipped, the snapshot is appended to meta_history.jsonl, and ensure_meta returns the newest snapshot. For each attempt, give the exact sequence (files, timestamps, yt-dlp replies) and the code path it takes. Report ONLY the attempts that succeed, quoting the lines that let them through. If none succeeds, answer PASS with no findings.

GOALS (any one is a finding):
X1. Keep a video frozen as live after its stream has ended, across runs.
X2. Make YouTube be asked more than once per META_RECHECK_S per video, or on every call.
X3. Change or overwrite meta.json, or make ensure_meta return another video's or a torn snapshot.
X4. Make acquire raise where it used to return a status: a yt-dlp failure, a bad metadata_fetched_at, an unreadable history.
X5. Make a finished video (was_live, not_live, none) be read again, or a post_live video now be skipped.

index 2feb420e..f751023f 100644

@@ -6,7 +6,8 @@ Every transcript and every derived chunk carries immutable attribution to its so
 
 Layout (data/editorial/transcripts/<video_id>/):
   meta.json                         video metadata (RSS + yt-dlp), written once, refreshed only
-                                    by appending to meta_history
+                                    by appending to meta_history.jsonl (one whole snapshot a line);
+                                    ensure_meta returns the newest snapshot
   transcript.<method>.json          IMMUTABLE transcript record, one per acquisition method
                                     (never overwritten; a better method adds a new file)
   attempts.jsonl                    acquisition attempt log (caption 429s, failures, skips)
@@ -47,6 +48,9 @@ WHISPER_BATCH = 16

+LIVE_STATES = ("is_live", "is_upcoming", "post_live")   # stored while not yet a finished video: read again
+SKIP_LIVE = ("is_live", "is_upcoming")                   # still not a finished video on the newest read: skipped
+META_RECHECK_S = 20 * 60                    # at most one re-read per video in this long (the cron runs every 30 min)
 CAPTION_BACKOFF_S = (0, 8, 20)
 CIRCUIT_MINUTES = 30
 CHUNK_MIN_S, CHUNK_MAX_S = 30.0, 60.0
@@ -114,22 +118,17 @@ def _ytdlp(args, timeout=120):
     return subprocess.run(cmd + args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
 
 
-def ensure_meta(video_id, rss=None, channel=None):

+def _fetch_meta(video_id, rss=None, channel=None, step="meta"):
+    """A metadata snapshot read from YouTube now (yt-dlp -J). AcquisitionError (logged) when it cannot be read."""
     r = _ytdlp(["-J", "--skip-download", canonical_url(video_id)])

     }
+
+
+def _newest_meta(video_id):
+    """meta.json, or the last whole snapshot of this video in meta_history.jsonl (a torn or foreign line is
+    skipped)."""
+    with open(os.path.join(_vdir(video_id), "meta.json")) as f:
+        meta = json.load(f)
+    hist = os.path.join(_vdir(video_id), "meta_history.jsonl")

+
+
+def ensure_meta(video_id, rss=None, channel=None):
+    """Video identity. rss = {'title','published'} from the channel feed (exact title and
+    publish timestamp); channel = registry entry. Returns the NEWEST meta snapshot: meta.json (written once)
+    or the last one refresh_meta appended to meta_history.jsonl."""
+    path = os.path.join(_vdir(video_id), "meta.json")
+    if os.path.exists(path):
+        return _newest_meta(video_id)
+    meta = _fetch_meta(video_id, rss=rss, channel=channel)
     os.makedirs(_vdir(video_id), exist_ok=True)
     _write_once(path, meta)
     return meta
 
 
+def refresh_meta(video_id, rss=None, channel=None, now=None):
+    """Read a video's metadata again and append the snapshot to meta_history.jsonl (meta.json stays write-once)
+    -> the newest snapshot. pp-ingest 2026-11-16 (INGEST-FAIL-01's pattern): Scott Melker f0NnJM63Ffc's meta.json
+    was written while its stream was live, and every run skipped it on that record long after the stream ended.
+    At most one read per META_RECHECK_S per video: a snapshot read more recently is returned as it is. A failed
+    read raises AcquisitionError (logged as step "meta_refresh") and appends nothing."""
+    cur = _newest_meta(video_id)
+    try:
+        last = datetime.fromisoformat(cur.get("metadata_fetched_at")).timestamp()
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        last = None
+    if last is not None and (time.time() if now is None else now) - last < META_RECHECK_S:
+        return cur
+    fresh = _fetch_meta(video_id, rss=rss, channel=channel, step="meta_refresh")
+    with open(os.path.join(_vdir(video_id), "meta_history.jsonl"), "a") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(fresh, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+    _log_attempt(video_id, step="meta_refresh", live_status=fresh.get("live_status"),
+                 was=cur.get("live_status"))
+    return fresh
+
+
 # ── transcript records ──
 
 def transcript_records(video_id):
@@ -449,10 +497,15 @@ def acquire(video_id, rss=None, channel=None, allow_whisper=True, prefer_words=F
         return rec, "cached"
     prefer_whisper = prefer_words
     meta = ensure_meta(video_id, rss=rss, channel=channel)
+    if meta.get("live_status") in LIVE_STATES:         # taken while not yet a finished video: read it again
